subject: gk
question: Which of the following is the central objective of Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 scheme?

options.text: Strengthening early childhood care and nutrition delivery systems

solution:
The correct answer is __**Strengthening early childhood care and nutrition delivery systems**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0** scheme aims to strengthen **early childhood care, nutrition delivery, and development**.
 
• It integrates the **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS), Poshan Abhiyaan, and Scheme for Adolescent Girls** for a comprehensive approach to nutrition and care.
 
• The scheme focuses on **malnutrition eradication** by providing supplementary nutrition to children (0-6 years), pregnant women, and lactating mothers.
 
• **Modernization of Anganwadi centers** is a key component, ensuring better infrastructure and services for early childhood care.
 
• The initiative emphasizes **community participation** and behavioral change to address nutrition challenges at the grassroots level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS):**

 
 
• Launched in 1975, it is one of the world’s largest programs aimed at providing food, preschool education, and primary healthcare to children under 6 years and their mothers.
 
• It includes immunization, health check-ups, and referral services.
 
 
 
• **Poshan Abhiyaan:**
 
 
• Also known as the National Nutrition Mission, it was launched in March 2018 to address malnutrition through a life-cycle approach.
 
• It aims to reduce stunting, undernutrition, anemia, and low birth weight among children.
 
 
 
• **Anganwadi Centres:**
 
 
• These are village-level child care centers established under ICDS to deliver nutrition, education, and health services.
 
• Modernization efforts under Saksham Anganwadi include smart learning modules, better sanitation, and hygienic food preparation.
 
 
 
• **Malnutrition in India:**
 
 
• According to the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5), stunting affects 35.5% of children under 5 years in India.
 
• The scheme aims to address root causes such as inadequate dietary intake and poor maternal nutrition.
